notes: India Sep 2020 (Rs 14,999). 48MP + 8MP UW 119° + 2MP macro + 2MP depth, 65W charging. Android 11 stable (realme UI 2.0, RMX2161_11_C.09, Jul 2021) confirmed final. Discontinued. ARCore certified (RMX2161L1 in the official supported-devices CSV).
caveats: 119° advertised UW passes on paper, but Realme/ColorOS is documented as blocking third-party Camera2 access to aux cameras (GCam package-name loophole explicitly does not work on Oppo/Realme); the app's CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO sub-1.0 probe is unverified on this model — runtime probe required, expect compat-check rejection. Android 11 max is the bare floor for CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO with zero headroom; no security updates since ~2022. Helio G95 has HW HEVC encode (H.265 listed by MediaTek) but is in the risky MTK Helio tier: timestamp-ignoring rate control (WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT on OMX.MTK) and isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) unverified — silent CBR→VBR fallback risk. ARCore certified, so IMU calibration + camera↔IMU timing are a strong positive, but sustained 100 Hz under camera load on this 12nm budget gaming SoC is untested, as is 25-min thermal sustain. Launched at Rs 14,999 — well below the app's Rs 30K+ target band. India only; never sold in Brazil.

notes: India May 2022 (Rs 21,999). 48MP + 8MP UW 119° + 2MP macro. Android 14 stable confirmed (realme UI 5.0, RMX3395_14.0.0.100(EX01), Apr 2024) — final per 2-major-update commitment. Discontinued. ARCore certified (RE879EL1 / Dimensity 920 in the official supported-devices CSV).
caveats: Strongest candidate in this batch — ARCore certified (IMU calibration + camera↔IMU timing validated), 119° advertised UW, Android 14, 6nm SoC — but still held at Unverified because the decisive gate is unverifiable: Realme/ColorOS documented third-party aux-camera lockdown means CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO sub-1.0 reachability of the UW is doubtful without an on-device probe (celsoazevedo FAQ: package-name workarounds do not work on Oppo/Realme). Dimensity 920 (MT6877V) is mid-Dimensity/mixed tier: WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT on MTK encoders (timestamp-ignoring rate control) and isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) is unverified — silent CBR→VBR fallback risk; same MT6877V family as Dimensity 1080, which had Android-15 c2.mtk HEVC plumbing breakage (decode-side, but a fragility signal). 25-min thermal sustain untested. Recommend prioritizing this model for a physical probe — if the UW probe and CBR check pass on hardware it could be promoted to Likely. India only; never sold in Brazil.
